issue.title: Segfault in gc_free_threading.c after PR #140262 with ASAN build and free-threading tests

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

issue.body:
# Bug report ### Bug description: Segmentation fault occurs in `gc_free_threading.c` when running `test_asyncio.test_free_threading` after PR #140262. **Build configuration:** ``` CC=clang CXX=clang++ ./configure --with-address-sanitizer --with-pydebug --disable-gil && make -j$(nproc) ``` **Reproduction:** ``` ./python -X dev -m test -R 3:3 test_asyncio.test_free_threading ``` The crash occurs intermittently, but is reproducible 100% of the time with `-R 3:3` or higher.
